# JBJ Global Real Estate

> Dubai's premier RERA-licensed property brokerage. Buy, sell, or rent luxury apartments, villas, and off-plan properties across the UAE.

JBJ Global Real Estate, founded by Jane Bou Jaoude, is a Dubai-headquartered brokerage serving investors, end-users, and developers across the United Arab Emirates. The platform combines a curated property portfolio with AI-powered tools, market intelligence, and concierge services for buyers, sellers, tenants, landlords, and brokers.
